title: Recompute the Smith census mixture prediction and Wilson interval from the committed tables
prompt: The research-kb server may be unreachable in this environment; if so, record that under 'Sources checked' and use the repository's own files. Every number you report is an unverified assertion unless a pcc claim says otherwise; tag it. From the committed tables in `research/smith_near_prime_20261114/tables.md` only (no new run), recompute: (a) the by-k mixture prediction of the pass rate for the admitted population (admitted k-distribution times the all-curve pass rate at each k, over k = 1 to 4), and (b) the Wilson 95% interval of the pooled admitted pass count. Write `$T_OUT/recompute.json` with keys `mixture_prediction`, `pooled_admitted_pass`, `pooled_admitted`, `wilson_lo`, `wilson_hi`, and a short `$T_OUT/recompute.md` saying whether the committed RESULTS.md agrees. Do not edit the study. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
acceptance: wilson_lo within 0.0010 of 0.0877 and wilson_hi within 0.0010 of 0.1318
check_command: python3 -c "import json,os;r=json.load(open(os.environ['T_OUT']+'/recompute.json'));assert r['pooled_admitted_pass']==82 and r['pooled_admitted']==761;assert abs(r['mixture_prediction']-0.1192)<0.0005;assert abs(r['wilson_lo']-0.0877)<0.001 and abs(r['wilson_hi']-0.1318)<0.001" && grep -q 'pcc:unverified' "$T_OUT/recompute.md" && python3 tools/pcc/pcc.py lint-prose "$T_OUT/recompute.md" && git diff --quiet "$T_BASE" HEAD -- research/smith_near_prime_20261114
